categories.name: Beach Tours
categories.description: Sri Lanka’s coast dazzles with golden beaches, turquoise waters, vibrant coral reefs, and bustling fishing villages, offering relaxation, adventure, rich culture, and breathtaking sunsets along its endless tropical shoreline.

categories.name: Cultural Tours
categories.description: Step into a land where every smile tells a story, every temple whispers history, and every meal is a celebration. Our cultural tours take you beyond sightseeing into the real Sri Lanka. Walk ancient paths, share tea with locals, witness timeless rituals, and feel the island’s rhythm in your soul. Whether it’s a village drumbeat or a monk’s quiet chant, you’ll carry the spirit of Sri Lanka long after your journey ends.

categories.name: Adventure Tours
categories.description: Experience thrilling adventure tours in Sri Lanka with hikes, wildlife safaris, water sports, and mountain treks—ideal for nature lovers and thrill-seekers chasing unforgettable outdoor moments.

categories.name: Wildlife Tours
categories.description: Discover Sri Lanka’s rich biodiversity through lush rainforests, serene national parks, and vibrant wildlife. Experience nature up close in Yala, Wilpattu, Sinharaja, and Minneriya on unforgettable eco-adventures.

categories.name: Ayurvedic Tours
categories.description: Rejuvenate your mind and body with Sri Lanka’s authentic Ayurvedic tours. Experience traditional healing, herbal treatments, massages, and wellness rituals rooted in centuries of ancient wisdom and natural balance.

categories.name: Hill Country Tours
categories.description: Experience the beauty of Sri Lanka’s hill country with scenic train rides, lush tea estates, charming towns, and refreshing mountain air-perfect for nature lovers and peaceful getaways.

categories.name: Honeymoon Tours
categories.description: Celebrate love with romantic honeymoon tours in Sri Lanka, featuring stunning beaches, serene hill stations, luxury resorts, candlelight dinners, and unforgettable moments for couples seeking intimacy and adventure together.

categories.name: Family Tours
categories.description: Experience unforgettable family moments exploring Sri Lanka’s vibrant culture, stunning landscapes, wildlife safaris, beautiful beaches, and exciting activities suitable for all ages and interests.

categories.name: Golf Tours
categories.description: Tee off across Sri Lanka’s scenic golf courses nestled in lush hills, coastal plains, and colonial settings. Enjoy world-class greens, cool climates, and unforgettable golfing experiences.

categories.name: Ramayana Tours
categories.description: Explore sacred sites, epic tales, temples, caves, Ashok Vatika, Seetha Eliya, Hanuman footprints and Ravana’s palace where history, mythology, and breathtaking landscapes come together in one unforgettable journey.

tours.shortDescription: Twelve days and eleven nights through Negombo, Habarana, Kandy, Nuwara Eliya and Ella, returning via Galle and Colombo.
tours.description: Combine Minneriya wildlife viewing with Hiriwadunna village, Sigiriya, a hot air balloon experience and Dambulla Cave Temple. In Kandy, visit the Temple of the Tooth and Ambuluwawa Tower and experience a cultural show. Continue to a tea factory and the Ella sights: Nine Arch Bridge, Mini Adam's Peak and Ravana Falls. Visit Galle Dutch Fort before time for Colombo city sightseeing and shopping.

tours.name: Adventure, Culture & Love
tours.shortDescription: Seventeen days and sixteen nights combining cultural sites, hill-country scenery, wildlife and southern beaches.
tours.description: Explore Habarana, Sigiriya, Hiriwadunna and Minneriya, with a balloon experience and Anuradhapura visit. Discover Dambulla Cave Temple, Kandy's Temple of the Tooth, a cultural show, Ambuluwawa Tower and the Royal Botanical Garden. Continue through Nuwara Eliya for Ramboda Falls, Gregory Lake and a strawberry farm, then Ella for Nine Arch Bridge, Mini Adam's Peak and Ravana Falls. The southern section features Yala National Park, Mirissa, Galle Dutch Fort, Kosgoda Sea Turtle Hatchery and a Bentota sunset cruise. Finish with Colombo city sightseeing, shopping and street food.
